summary: Backend analytics endpoints fully tested. All 11 pytest cases passed covering personal (/api/analytics/me) and admin (/api/analytics/admin/*) routes, plus auth gating (401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 403 guest), shape validation, day-clamping, and no-_id leak assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: ADMIN_EMAILS is not set in /app/backend/.env — the code falls back to the hard-coded default 'mattsossi@bsossi.com'. For production, set this explicitly in env (also avoid shipping default admin in code).
/admin/recent-users issues N+1 prep_data + summaries queries per user (acceptable at limit<=100, but consider $lookup/aggregation if user base grows).
Funnel uses 5 individual count_documents calls — fine for now, could be collapsed into a single aggregation.
Guest -> claim conversion is approximated via regex on user_id starting with 'guest_' — comment in code already acknowledges this; consider tracking a 'claimed_from_guest_id' field for accuracy.
_now()-based 7d/30d windows compare ISO strings against created_at — works only because created_at is stored as ISO-8601 UTC strings with the same format. Brittle if the schema ever stores datetimes.
seed_data_creation: Both accounts auto-created (or logged-in if pre-existing) via _ensure_account helper. test also calls PUT /api/mediation/readiness so personal analytics has data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Analytics suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_analytics.py — reusable. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin gating relies on default ADMIN_EMAILS=mattsossi@bsossi.com (env override possible).
verified_endpoints: GET /api/analytics/me -> 401 unauth, 200 with full shape (user.email, progress.steps_done, steps_total=5, readiness.current, readiness.trend, activity.summaries/agreements/mediator_emails, recent_summaries[])

GET /api/analytics/admin/overview -> 401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 403 guest, 200 admin with users.total/new_7d/auth_breakdown, engagement.summaries_total, magic_links.conversion_pct, funnel for all 5 sections
GET /api/analytics/admin/recent-users?limit=5 -> 200 admin, returns users with steps_done/steps_total=5/summaries; 403 non-admin
No MongoDB _id leak detected in any response (recursive walk assertion)
